pier_fiddler.text: Pull up a bench. There is music most nights here, and the tunes go on until someone has a boat to catch.
Tunes come in types. A jig is in 6/8, a reel in 4/4, and a slide in 12/8, which sounds like falling down a hill, in a good way.
At a session you wait until a tune has ended before you join in. It is polite, and it saves the fiddlers a headache.

arc_ie_singer.text: A crew that cannot keep time will row in circles. Sing with the bar and the word goes up and down the coast by Friday.

else.text: That will carry. The bar will tell the boats.
